events.title: Demo Update - Bug Fixes, Tutorial, Extra Stats
events.summary: Hey everyone!Here are a few more improvements in this update:Added a dedicated tutorial levelAdded an inspect panel that appears when clicking on SubjectsFixed several bugs, mainly related to how Subjects fetch tasksAdjusted some item values for better balanceIMPORTANT: If you have an ongoing run, playing the tutorial will require you to wipe your current level progress.Thanks to everyone who's been playing the demo and sharing feedback!Have fun!

events.title: Demo Update – Bug Fixes & Balance Changes
events.summary: Hey everyone!I've just updated the demo with a few improvements:Fixed several bugsAdjusted some item values for better balanceMade a few other minor improvementsRemoved one merchant shop from the mapThanks to everyone who's been playing the demo and sharing feedback! I really appreciate the support.Have fun, and let me know what you think!
